title: Quality and Beautiful
text: Quality and Beautiful. I gave it as a gift to a farm wife, who needed some things after 20 years of marriage. I previously gave her Rachael Ray kitchen gifts, she said she felt like a queen, they are so luxurious with quality, she also bakes a lot. She loves the touch of color.

product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray 55673 Nonstick Bakeware Set with Grips includes Nonstick Bread Pan, Baking Pans and Cake Pans - 5 Piece, Gray with Orange Grips
features: SET INCLUDES: Two 9-Inch Round Cake Pans, 9-Inch x 13-Inch Rectangular Cake Pan, 10-Inch x 15-Inch Crispy Sheet Pan and 9-Inch x 5-Inch Loaf Pan
DURABLE BAKEWARE: These baking pans are made from heavy gauge steel for fast, even heat that resists warping
OVEN SAFE BAKING PANS: Bake pans are oven safe to 500 degrees F with bold-colored, extra-wide grippy handles for comfort and control
HIGH-QUALITY NONSTICK: Long-lasting, enhanced nonstick bakeware provides excellent food release and easy cleanup
FEEL GOOD BAKING: A portion of the proceeds goes to Yum-o!(r), Rachael's nonprofit that helps kids and their parents develop healthy relationships with food and cooking
BAKE LIKE RACH: This bakeware set is the perfect complement to many other pieces in Rachael's bakeware and cookware collections that always spell fun in the kitchen
description: Add a full line-up of essential bakeware to your kitchen and support a good cause at the same time with this set. This set includes two round cake pans, one cake pan, one loaf pan, and one cookie sheet. Created with a kick of Rachael Ray style, pieces in the Oven Lovin' 5-piece bakeware set feature a long-lasting nonstick surface and innovative silicone grips built into the handles for comfort. A great choice for various baking needs, including cake, bread, cookies, and more, these pieces offer extra-wide handles for a confident grasp--even with bulky potholders. A portion of the proceeds from this purchase will be donated to Rachael Ray's charity, Yum-o!, which was created to empower kids and their families to develop healthy relationships with food and cooking.
Round Cake Pans -- 9" diameter; Rectangle Cake Pan -- 9" L x 13" W; Deep Rectangle Loaf Pan -- 9" L x 5" W; Crispy Sheet Cookie Pan -- 10" L x 15" W
